commentary.text: 90+6' Davide Massa is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
90+4' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:6.
90+2' Scott McTominay (Napoli) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel was alert and made a comfortable save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
88' Adam Marusic (Lazio) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!

83' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
82' The game is interrupted now, Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is awarded a second yellow by Davide Massa and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
80' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
79' It will be a substitution. Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Amir Rrahmani walks off.
78' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) replaces Leonardo Spinazzola.
78' What a chance that is! Pasquale Mazzocchi swings the ball into the box, and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
77' Toma Basic (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared.

76' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
75' Matteo Politano (Napoli) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
75' 3:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
74' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) plays a lovely through ball to Reda Belahyane, but he can't beat Vanja Milinkovic-Savic and loses the ball.
73' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
71' Substitution. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) has come on for Matteo Cancellieri.
71' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Danilo Cataldi is replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).

64' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
64' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) sends the corner into the box, but Ivan Provedel intercepts it and averts the threat.
62' Substitution. Luca Pellegrini leaves the pitch and is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).

59' David Neres (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
57' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Davide Massa blows his whistle as Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
53' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
53' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
51' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tackles a bit over-zealously and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
51' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
49' A cross from the by-line finds Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
48' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
48' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
47' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Napoli.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.

42' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Scott McTominay (Napoli) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
38' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
35' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.
35' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
34' No foul! Referee Davide Massa points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Napoli players celebrate.
33' Wait! Referee Davide Massa has indicated he is going to review the Napoli goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

17' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Matteo Politano (Napoli).

15' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Leonardo Spinazzola, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

12' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) fails to send in a decent cross from the free kick from the edge of the box. His effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
11' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Davide Massa signals. Napoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
8' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
8' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Rasmus Hojlund is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by David Neres (Napoli).
6' Matteo Politano floats over the corner and Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
